calculation.description: Ranks assets by established 20-trading-day trend while discounting the most recent five-day move; positive values indicate medium-term strength with less recent overextension. Signal is lagged at decision use.

validation.regime_notes: Five-day IC was below gate; ten-day horizon passed. Regime IC/ICIR: 2020-21 +0.02146/+0.06009, 2022-23 -0.00185/-0.00515, 2024-25 -0.01361/-0.03986, 2026-2027-02-24 +0.03384/+0.10089. Interpret conservatively because the cross-section is 15 instruments and horizon-specific persistence is regime dependent.
